name: cdxgen
description: OWASP cdxgen toolkit for coding agents: generate, enrich, audit, sign, validate, convert, and explore CycloneDX BOMs (SBOM, CBOM, HBOM, OBOM, SaaSBOM, AI-BOM, VDR) across source code, containers, live hosts, and hardware.

lockfile_reminder.title: Lockfile reminder
lockfile_reminder.description: Remind Claude that an SBOM is stale after it edits a lockfile or dependency manifest.

dependency_track_url.title: Dependency-Track server URL
dependency_track_url.description: Base URL of your Dependency-Track server, for example https://deptrack.example.com. Leave empty to be asked each time. The API key is not stored here; set it in your own shell environment.

tea_endpoint.title: TEA endpoint
tea_endpoint.description: Base URL of your TEA server for --tea-publish. Leave empty to be asked each time. The TEA token is not stored here; set TEA_TOKEN in your own shell environment.

spec_version.title: Default CycloneDX spec version
spec_version.description: Value for --spec-version when you do not ask for one, for example 1.6, 1.7 or 2.0. Leave empty to use the cdxgen default.

runtime.title: Preferred runtime
runtime.description: Enter local to run the cdxgen CLI from PATH, or container to run the ghcr.io/cdxgen/cdxgen image. Leave empty for local.
